experiments.deviceModel: Synthetic fixtures first; owned physical lab device is a separate gate.
experiments.osFirmware: Exact test fixture or owned-device build required per result.
experiments.environment: Isolated local workstation; no production personal data.
experiments.equipment: Workstation and synthetic fixture; owned lab phone/cable only for separately authorized physical trial.
experiments.authorizedScope: Synthetic/public evidence and expressly owned/authorized lab devices only.
experiments.methodology: Record lab inventory and consent; collect existing read-only descriptors/properties; compare with reference; disconnect and record unchanged state.

experiments.limitations: A successful synthetic test cannot certify a physical phone or commercial service.
